not_measurable: groundable opening: the released logs retain no tool responses and no entry snapshot

corpora.scaffold: four official baseline architectures (ReAct, plan-and-execute, iterative parallel function calling, full code + reflection)

definitions.arms: each released corpus carries one labelled sensitivity arm: shell reads admitted (allowlisted single-utility invocations flipped to READ_LOCAL) for the coding corpora; pre-tool user turns folded into entry state for tau-bench
definitions.families: canonical hashes of opening windows (one per episode and hash, the largest); support is the number of distinct groups (tasks); at floor = >=3 groups as in Table 4
definitions.first_model_boundary: the first agent turn after the task prompt; normalized position 0 is the first tool call
definitions.groundable_opening: the longest Algorithm 2 window starting at the first boundary with every slot LITERAL, NOT_GROUNDABLE or GROUNDED (entry state or prior result, depth<=2, kappa=3) and live-ins within the entry schema; share counts episodes whose longest such window has >=2 calls
definitions.n_max_vs_floor: largest family support against the 92 zero-violation groups Eq. (cp) requires
definitions.read_only_opening: consecutive calls from position 0 whose catalog entry is compilable (read-like with speculatable+replayable capabilities); a new user utterance, an unknown effect, a write, an approval-gated tool or a missing capability ends it

evidence_class: provider-free trace analysis of released benchmark trajectories; descriptive, not admission
not_evidence_for: admission, calibration, or dispatch of any artifact
quality of any compiled program (nothing is synthesized or replayed here)
